title: A股开盘确认科技补跌，天赐逆势与美晨摘帽冲高强化事件分化
summary: 截至09:56，上证、深证与创业板约跌1.25%、1.97%和3.17%，确认隔夜科技风险传导；天赐材料逆势涨2.34%，金刚光伏涨9.22%但兑现风险仍高，美晨科技摘帽复牌涨13.19%，事件分化强于大盘但追涨风险上升。

重大新闻汇总
国际
美股AI与半导体链遭遇19个月最深单日下跌
11月5日美股收盘，纳指跌5.52%、标普500跌4.36%、道指跌3.44%；英伟达跌逾9%，费城半导体指数跌逾12%，成交量显著放大。AI基础设施监管担忧与加息信号共同压制风险偏好。来源：Reuters。
排行
广告领涨、硬件与半导体领跌，板块分化极端
11月5日现金时段，广告代理+18.99%，APP +31.04%；固态电池概念+8.81%，TM +9.35%。相反，电子元件-10.37%、半导体-11.46%、半导体设备-12.33%、电气设备-12.53%、计算机硬件-14.94%。来源：GitHub Actions/Moomoo 08:33 CST快照。
夜盘
ETF代理延续弱势，未出现明确盘后反转
运行时公开报价约08:20 CST：QQQ 647.05美元、较前收-6.33%；SPY 733.00美元、-4.35%；DIA 514.27美元、-3.50%。三者是延长时段代理，涨跌为相对前收的累计变化，来源未拆分收盘后单独增量。
政策
北京新型能源体系规划明确储能与电网技术方向
规划提出推动固态、液流等电池技术研发，发展系统集成与高端制造，到2030年新型储能装机达到60万千瓦；同时推进智能电网、电力芯片和“人工智能+能源”。方向明确，但地方规划不等于公司订单。来源：北京市政府规划原文。
政策
全面节约战略把算力节能、节水与循环利用纳入硬目标
国家发展改革委等五部门要求推进算力、通信基站和机房节能降碳改造，并强化农业节水、工业水效和动力电池全生命周期管理。到2030年单位GDP能耗和用水量均较2025年下降约10%。来源：国家发展改革委通知、方案原文。
科技
晶合集成四期晶圆产线获大额增资与回购安排
晶合集成拟与合肥建投、合肥勤合向晶奕集成合计增资91亿元，公司出资51亿元并继续控股；项目建设12英寸晶圆产线，规划产能约5.5万片/月。同时公司拟回购5亿至8亿元股份。资本开支、良率和需求兑现仍需跟踪。来源：财联社公告汇总、巨潮资讯公告检索。
公告
宏盛华源中标约7.25亿元国家电网项目
子公司在输变电及特高压材料招标中中标26个标包，金额约7.25亿元，占2025年经审计营收7.57%；正式合同尚未签署。11月5日收盘3.79元、涨0.80%，价格早于盘后公告。来源：公告转录、收盘行情。
公告
大禹节水联合体中标21.44亿元灌区项目
安庆下浒山水库灌区项目采用“股权投资+EPCO”，但公司承担的建设和运营份额约9.77%，项目合作期长达40年，不能把联合体总金额直接视为公司收入。11月5日收盘3.34元、涨2.14%。来源：公告转录、收盘行情。
公告
金刚光伏云计算合同上限15.36亿元，但股价已先涨停
控股子公司签署算力云服务合同，含税预估总价不超过15.36亿元，首两批合计约3.84亿元；交易对手未完整披露，最终收入取决于交付量和价格。11月5日收盘18.66元、涨20%，公告前已充分交易。来源：公司公告转录、收盘行情。
公告
天赐材料签订45万吨电解液长期供货协议
子公司拟于2027至2029年向亿纬锂能供应合计45万吨电解液，实际采购量和价格以订单为准。11月5日收盘29.01元、涨5.45%，同样早于盘后公告；该液态电解液协议不能直接等同于固态电池受益。来源：公告索引、收盘行情。
盘中
A股开盘确认隔夜科技风险传导，创业板跌逾3%
截至09:56 CST，上证指数3643.85点、跌1.25%，深证成指跌1.97%，创业板指跌3.17%。这把首轮“今日需验证”的隔夜风险转化为已确认的盘中补跌，科技与高弹性方向继续降风险；行情来自公开延迟报价。
公告
美晨科技摘帽复牌涨逾13%，事件确认但追涨风险上升
公司获深交所同意撤销其他风险警示，11月6日起复牌并由“ST美晨”更名为“美晨科技”，涨跌幅限制仍为20%；截至09:56报2.66元、涨13.19%。摘帽催化已被价格快速交易，历史诉讼、资产处置与盈利修复仍需核验，列条件关注而非看多确认。来源：巨潮资讯公告检索、公开延迟行情。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
风险资产仍未出现可验证反转
纳指现金时段跌5.52%、标普500跌4.36%、道指跌3.44%；09:56复核时，公开延迟源的QQQ最近可得报价仍为647.05美元、较前收-6.49%，实际行情时间05:00 CST，SPY/DIA未取得更晚可靠报价。延迟限制不改变A股开盘已确认的风险传导。
板块对照
硬件与半导体弱势获A股开盘确认，广告与固态电池仍仅公司级映射
电子元件、半导体、设备、电气零件和计算机硬件隔夜均跌逾10%，创业板开盘后跌3.17%构成“确认”；广告代理与固态电池为相对强势，但缺少A/H板块级同步报价，仍属“背离待验证”，未出现足以定义为“反转”的证据。
A/H映射
科技风险从预判转为实盘确认，个股事件分化上升
天赐材料+2.34%相对大盘强势，宏盛华源-0.26%未确认中标催化；金刚光伏+9.22%但兑现与追涨风险仍高，睿创微纳-1.17%尚未扭转前日大跌。美晨科技+13.19%是摘帽事件交易，不代表市场风险偏好整体修复。

盘前结论

截至09:56，上证、深证与创业板分别约跌1.25%、1.97%和3.17%，隔夜AI硬件与半导体抛售已从盘前风险变成A股实盘补跌确认，科技与高弹性方向继续降风险。

个股分化明显：天赐材料逆势涨2.34%但协议量价仍待订单确认；金刚光伏涨9.22%却仍有公告前抢跑与兑现风险；宏盛华源平弱、睿创微纳小跌，均不足以改写防守判断。

美晨科技摘帽复牌涨13.19%构成新增事件线索，但催化已被快速交易，历史诉讼、资产处置及盈利修复仍需验证。其强势不能外推为A/H整体风险偏好修复。

重点个股关注

天赐材料
002709.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：45万吨电解液长期供货协议后，截至09:56报29.69元、涨2.34%，在三大指数下跌时相对强势。

确认条件：持续守住29.01元前收，订单量价与排产进一步确认，并保持相对锂电材料板块强势。

风险与失效：实际采购量和价格以订单为准，液态电解液不等于固态电池直接受益；跌回前收或明显弱于板块即降级。

美晨科技
300237.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：撤销其他风险警示并复牌，截至09:56报2.66元、涨13.19%，摘帽事件得到价格确认。

确认条件：放量换手后仍能守住复牌缺口，且资产处置、诉讼风险与盈利修复出现可核验进展。

风险与失效：摘帽不等于基本面风险消失，涨幅已大；冲高回落、跌破开盘区间或新增诉讼/处置不确定性均使观察逻辑失效。

宏盛华源
601096.SH
条件关注

事实与状态：约7.25亿元国家电网中标占2025年营收7.57%，但截至09:56报3.78元、跌0.26%，开盘未确认催化。

确认条件：正式合同签署并重新站上3.79元，持续强于输变电设备同业。

风险与失效：合同未签、交付和毛利率未知；若持续低于前收并弱于同业，降级为无候选。

金刚光伏
300093.SZ
回避

事实与状态：云服务合同上限15.36亿元且交易对手未完整披露；截至09:56报20.38元、涨9.22%，延续公告前涨停后的高波动。

重新评估条件：客户、交付、回款与利润贡献被持续验证，价格在充分换手后稳定且板块风险缓和。

风险与失效：上限金额不等于收入，公告前抢跑叠加隔夜硬件/电气行业暴跌，正价格反馈不足以消除追涨风险。

睿创微纳
688002.SH
回避

事实与状态：11月5日跌15.42%后，截至09:56报127.89元、再跌1.17%；虽相对创业板更抗跌，但未形成止跌反转。

重新评估条件：出现连续止跌、放量承接并持续跑赢科创50和半导体同业，再评估基本面催化。

风险与失效：AI硬件去杠杆与监管担忧仍在，单一时点相对抗跌不得包装成看多机会。

板块轮动看板

相对强势摘帽复牌与少数合同事件；天赐材料相对大盘强，美晨科技涨幅突出但均需防冲高回落
条件观察输变电中标、储能与电解液；宏盛华源开盘未确认，天赐材料仍需量价和板块持续性
压力方向半导体、设备、电子元件、电气零件与计算机硬件，创业板跌逾3%确认高弹性压力
验证信号创业板能否收复2500点附近；天赐守29.01元，美晨守开盘区间，宏盛重新站上3.79元

逻辑链

美股AI监管担忧 + 半导体和硬件暴跌 → A股三大指数开盘全面下跌 → 科技风险从预判变为实盘确认。
创业板-3.17%而天赐材料+2.34% → 电解液协议出现相对价格确认 → 仍因量价未定保持条件关注。
宏盛华源-0.26% → 中标催化尚未获开盘确认 → 等正式合同与重新站上3.79元。
金刚光伏+9.22%但公告前已涨停 + 合同兑现不确定 → 正反馈与高追涨风险并存 → 维持回避。
美晨科技摘帽复牌+13.19% → 事件交易强于大盘 → 只作高风险条件观察，不外推为市场反转。

风险雷达

隔夜传导已确认创业板跌逾3%，科技和高弹性方向若反弹无量仍可能二次下探。
公告兑现中标、框架和合同上限均不等于已确认收入；金刚光伏的正价格反馈不能消除客户、交付与回款不确定性。
摘帽追涨美晨科技摘帽不等于基本面风险消失，13%以上涨幅放大冲高回落与换手风险。
报价口径A股为公开延迟行情；QQQ最近可得报价实际时间05:00 CST，SPY/DIA未取得更晚可靠报价，未用旧数据冒充实时反转。

数据来源与时间点

增量研究与A股报价截止2026-11-06 09:56 CST；A股指数及个股为东方财富公开延迟报价。美股指数与板块为11月5日现金时段；09:56复核时QQQ最近可得报价仍为647.05美元、-6.49%，实际行情时间05:00 CST，SPY/DIA未取得更晚可靠报价。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-05 14:48:03 CST，仅为首轮基线。新增来源：巨潮资讯美晨科技公告检索、交易所停复牌汇总及公开延迟行情；其余首轮事实来源保持Reuters、北京市政府、国家发展改革委、交易所/巨潮资讯和GitHub Actions/Moomoo。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates importance, not performance.
Major News
Global
AI and chip rout delivers Nasdaq’s steepest daily fall in 19 months
On November 5, the Nasdaq fell 5.52%, the S&P 500 4.36% and the Dow 3.44%. Nvidia lost more than 9% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index more than 12% on heavy volume. AI-infrastructure regulation concerns and renewed rate-hike signals hit risk appetite. Source: Reuters.
Ranking
Advertising leads while hardware and semiconductors collapse
For the November 5 cash session, Advertising Agencies rose 18.99% with APP +31.04%, while Solid State Battery gained 8.81% with TM +9.35%. Electronic Components fell 10.37%, Semiconductors 11.46%, Semiconductor Equipment 12.33%, Electrical Equipment 12.53% and Computer Hardware 14.94%. Source: GitHub Actions/Moomoo snapshot at 08:33 CST.
Overnight
ETF proxies remain weak with no clear after-hours reversal
Public quotes around 08:20 CST showed QQQ at $647.05 (-6.33% versus the prior close), SPY at $733.00 (-4.35%) and DIA at $514.27 (-3.50%). These are extended-hours proxies; the changes are cumulative versus the prior close and do not isolate the post-close move.
Policy
Beijing energy plan targets storage and smart-grid technologies
The plan calls for R&D in solid-state and flow batteries, system integration and high-end manufacturing, with 600 MW of new energy storage by 2030. It also promotes smart grids, power chips and “AI + Energy.” A local plan is directionally supportive but is not a company order. Source: Beijing government plan.
Policy
National conservation plan adds hard targets for computing efficiency and water use
Five agencies call for energy-efficiency upgrades in computing facilities, base stations and server rooms, together with agricultural water saving, industrial water efficiency and battery lifecycle management. By 2030, energy and water use per unit of GDP should each fall about 10% from 2025. Source: NDRC notice and full plan.
Technology
Nexchip unit receives RMB91bn capital injection and a buyback plan
Nexchip and two Hefei state-backed investors plan to inject RMB91bn into Jingyi Integrated; Nexchip contributes RMB51bn and retains control. The project is building a 12-inch wafer fab with planned capacity of about 55,000 wafers per month. Nexchip also announced a RMB500m–800m buyback. Capex, yield and demand execution remain key risks. Sources: CLS announcement digest and CNINFO filings.
Filing
Hongsheng Huayuan wins about RMB725m of State Grid tenders
Subsidiaries won 26 transmission and UHV-material packages worth about RMB725m, equal to 7.57% of audited 2025 revenue. Formal contracts have not been signed. The stock closed November 5 at RMB3.79, up 0.80%, before the after-close filing. Sources: filing transcript and closing quote.
Filing
Dayu consortium wins RMB2.144bn irrigation project
The Anqing Xiazhushan reservoir irrigation project uses an “equity investment + EPCO” structure, but Dayu’s construction and operating share is about 9.77% and the cooperation period is 40 years. The consortium value cannot be treated as Dayu revenue. The stock closed at RMB3.34, up 2.14%. Sources: filing transcript and closing quote.
Filing
Jingang Solar signs cloud-computing contract capped at RMB1.536bn after a limit-up move
A controlled unit signed a cloud-service contract with an estimated tax-inclusive ceiling of RMB1.536bn; the first two batches total about RMB384m. The counterparty is not fully disclosed and realized revenue depends on delivery and pricing. The stock had already closed limit-up at RMB18.66 before the filing. Sources: filing transcript and closing quote.
Filing
Tinci signs a 450,000-tonne electrolyte supply agreement
A subsidiary plans to supply EVE Energy with a total of 450,000 tonnes of electrolyte from 2027 to 2029; actual volumes and prices depend on orders. The stock closed at RMB29.01, up 5.45%, before the filing. This liquid-electrolyte agreement is not direct proof of solid-state-battery exposure. Sources: filing index and closing quote.
Intraday
A-share open confirms overnight technology-risk transmission
At 09:56 CST, the SSE Composite was down 1.25%, the Shenzhen Component 1.97% and ChiNext 3.17%. The first-round “needs opening confirmation” risk is now a verified catch-down, keeping technology and high-beta exposure on a lower risk setting. Quotes are public and delayed.
Filing
Meichen jumps more than 13% after risk-label removal, but chase risk rises
The Shenzhen exchange approved removal of the “other risk warning”; trading resumed on November 6 under the name Meichen Technology, with the daily limit still 20%. At 09:56 CST it was RMB2.66, up 13.19%. The catalyst is already being priced quickly, while legacy litigation, asset-disposal and earnings-recovery risks remain. It is a conditional watch, not a confirmed bullish call. Sources: CNINFO filing search and public delayed quotes.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Index
No verifiable risk-asset reversal
The Nasdaq cash session fell 5.52%, the S&P 500 4.36% and the Dow 3.44%. At the 09:56 recheck, the latest available public delayed QQQ quote remained $647.05, down 6.49% versus the prior close, with an actual market timestamp of 05:00 CST; no later reliable SPY/DIA quote was obtained. This delay does not negate the A-share open’s confirmed transmission.
Sector Check
Hardware and chip weakness is confirmed at the A-share open; adtech and solid-state remain company-level mappings
Electronic Components, Semiconductors, Equipment, Electrical Parts and Computer Hardware each fell more than 10% overnight, while ChiNext’s 3.17% opening decline is a “confirmation.” Advertising and Solid State Battery remain relative-strength groups, but without synchronized A/H sector quotes the signal is still a “divergence pending validation,” not a “reversal.”
A/H Map
Technology risk shifts from forecast to live confirmation as event dispersion rises
Tinci +2.34% outperformed the market, while Hongsheng Huayuan -0.26% did not confirm its tender catalyst. Jingang Solar +9.22% still carries execution and chase risk; Raytron -1.17% has not reversed the prior day’s plunge. Meichen +13.19% is a risk-label-removal trade, not broad risk-on confirmation.

Premarket Takeaway

At 09:56, the SSE Composite, Shenzhen Component and ChiNext were down about 1.25%, 1.97% and 3.17%. The overnight AI-hardware and semiconductor selloff has moved from forecast risk to live A-share catch-down confirmation, keeping technology and high-beta exposure on a lower risk setting.

Stock dispersion is high: Tinci rose 2.34% against the market but agreement volume and pricing still depend on orders; Jingang Solar gained 9.22% yet retains pre-filing and execution risks; Hongsheng Huayuan was slightly lower and Raytron remained negative, neither changing the defensive view.

Meichen Technology’s 13.19% jump after risk-label removal is a new event signal, but the catalyst is being priced quickly and legacy litigation, asset-disposal and earnings-recovery risks remain. Its strength cannot be extrapolated into a broad A/H risk-on signal.

Stocks to Watch

Tinci Materials
002709.SZ
Conditional Watch

Fact and status: After the 450,000-tonne electrolyte agreement, Tinci traded at RMB29.69, up 2.34% at 09:56, outperforming while all three major indexes fell.

Confirmation: It keeps holding above the RMB29.01 prior close, volume, pricing and production schedules are confirmed, and it remains strong versus battery-material peers.

Risk / invalidation: Actual purchases and prices depend on orders; liquid electrolyte is not direct solid-state exposure. A break below the prior close or clear sector underperformance triggers a downgrade.

Meichen Technology
300237.SZ
Conditional Watch

Fact and status: The risk-warning label was removed and trading resumed; at 09:56 the stock was RMB2.66, up 13.19%, confirming the event catalyst in price.

Confirmation: It holds the resumption gap after heavy turnover, while asset disposal, litigation risk and earnings recovery show verifiable progress.

Risk / invalidation: Label removal does not erase fundamental risk and the gain is already large. A failed spike, break below the opening range or new litigation/disposal uncertainty invalidates the watch.

Hongsheng Huayuan
601096.SH

Fact and status: The RMB725m State Grid tender wins equal 7.57% of 2025 revenue, but at 09:56 the stock was RMB3.78, down 0.26%, so the open did not confirm the catalyst.

Confirmation: Formal contracts are signed and the stock retakes RMB3.79 while outperforming transmission-equipment peers.

Risk / invalidation: Contracts are unsigned and delivery and margins are unknown. Persistent trading below the prior close and sector underperformance downgrade it to no candidate.

Jingang Solar
300093.SZ
Avoid

Fact and status: The cloud-service contract is capped at RMB1.536bn and the counterparty remains incompletely disclosed. At 09:56 the stock was RMB20.38, up 9.22%, extending high volatility after the pre-filing limit-up.

Reassessment: Customer identity, delivery, collection and profit contribution are repeatedly verified, the price stabilizes after sufficient turnover, and sector risk eases.

Risk / invalidation: The ceiling is not realized revenue. Pre-filing price action and the overnight hardware/electrical rout mean positive price feedback alone does not remove chase risk.

Raytron Technology

Fact and status: After falling 15.42% on Nov 5, Raytron was RMB127.89, down another 1.17% at 09:56. It outperformed ChiNext at that moment but had not formed a reversal.

Reassessment: Require sustained stabilization, volume-backed demand and continued outperformance versus STAR 50 and semiconductor peers before revisiting the catalyst.

Risk / invalidation: AI-hardware deleveraging and regulatory concerns remain; one point of relative resilience must not be reframed as bullish.
